svg.title: HyperOx mobile: Inbox
svg.text: M0.2b · design pass II · every agent on every machine, grouped by who needs you · light = paper · dark = darkmatter

g.text: Groups: Needs you · Working · Done · Idle (unknown status →
Idle). Row: status avatar, agent + folder, last line, machine +
mode tag, state tag. Permission prompts get Deny / Approve
right in the row; a question opens the agent.
Unread = accent dot; pinned = pin icon, pinned rows sort first
in their group. The Inbox tab badge counts "needs you".
03 tablet / foldable · rail + inbox + agent · light
Width ≥ 600 dp: inbox list beside the selected agent (here a question, so no Approve). Rows drop the inline buttons; the pane has them.
Agents from every machine land here,
grouped by who needs you. Add a
No machines: one clear action. With machines but no agents
the copy says "No agents running" and links to Spaces › Start
Skeleton rows while each machine answers; the line below
shows which machines are done (✓) or still loading (…).
Showing the last state from 9:12. Pull to
Every machine unreachable: the last state stays, greyed with
[offline]; Approve / Deny are hidden (they cannot be sent).

A machine waiting for this phone shows "Approve on
hidden in the SSH-only build). [account] and [ssh] agents mix
Search matches agent, folder, name and machine,
case-insensitive, live. Clear (×) restores the groups.
Swipe left on a row: Pin and Mark read (76 × 88 dp each).
Long-press opens the same actions as a menu for TalkBack.
ssh: connect to host devbox port 22: timed
out. Its agents are hidden until it answers.
One machine failing never blanks the inbox: a banner names
it with the SSH error, the others stay live. Retry targets that
First build (SSH only): no [account] machines, no approval
banner, no push; everything else is identical. Tags still say
[ssh] so the later account build adds rows, not layout.
